4.92. Ядро и образ (null space и column space) (Повтор перед контрольной, N9)

Find the null space and column space of the matrix M=[123246369]M = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 \\ 3 & 6 & 9 \end{bmatrix}.

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение
  1. Find the Row Echelon Form:
    • Perform row operations: R2→R2−2R1R_2 \to R_2 - 2R_1 and R3→R3−3R1R_3 \to R_3 - 3R_1.
    • [123000000]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
  2. Find the Null Space: Solve the system M𝐱=𝟎M\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}, which simplifies to the single equation x1+2x2+3x3=0x_1 + 2x_2 + 3x_3 = 0.
    • The first variable, x1x_1, is the pivot variable. The other two, x2x_2 and x3x_3, are free variables. Let x2=αx_2 = \alpha and x3=βx_3 = \beta.
    • x1=−2α−3βx_1 = -2\alpha - 3\beta.
    • The general solution is 𝐱=[−2α−3βαβ]=α[−210]+β[−301]\mathbf{x} = \begin{bmatrix} -2\alpha - 3\beta \\ \alpha \\ \beta \end{bmatrix} = \alpha\begin{bmatrix} -2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix} + \beta\begin{bmatrix} -3 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}.
    • The null space is the span of these two vectors.
  3. Find the Column Space: The column space is spanned by the pivot columns of the original matrix.
    • The first column is the only pivot column.
    • The column space is the span of the first column of M.

Ответ:

  • Null Space: The plane spanned by the vectors {[−210],[−301]}\left\{ \begin{bmatrix} -2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}, \begin{bmatrix} -3 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} \right\}.
  • Column Space: The line spanned by the vector [123]\begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}.
4.93. Система с параметром (Повтор перед контрольной, N10)

For what values of kk does the system have a unique solution, infinitely many solutions, or no solution? {x+y+z=1x+2y+4z=kx+4y+10z=k2 \begin{cases} x + y + z = 1 \\ x + 2y + 4z = k \\ x + 4y + 10z = k^2 \end{cases}

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение
  1. Row Reduce the Augmented Matrix:
    • [111|1124|k1410|k2]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 & | & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 4 & | & k \\ 1 & 4 & 10 & | & k^2 \end{bmatrix}
    • R2→R2−R1R_2 \to R_2 - R_1 and R3→R3−R1R_3 \to R_3 - R_1: [111|1013|k−1039|k2−1]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 & | & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & | & k-1 \\ 0 & 3 & 9 & | & k^2-1 \end{bmatrix}
    • R3→R3−3R2R_3 \to R_3 - 3R_2: [111|1013|k−1000|(k2−1)−3(k−1)]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 & | & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & | & k-1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & | & (k^2-1) - 3(k-1) \end{bmatrix}
  2. Analyze the Last Row: The equation for the last row is 0=(k2−1)−3(k−1)0 = (k^2-1) - 3(k-1).
    • Factor the expression: 0=(k−1)(k+1)−3(k−1)=(k−1)(k+1−3)=(k−1)(k−2)0 = (k-1)(k+1) - 3(k-1) = (k-1)(k+1-3) = (k-1)(k-2).
  3. Determine the Conditions:
    • No solution: This occurs when the last row is of the form [0,0,0|c][0, 0, 0 | c] where c≠0c \neq 0. This happens when (k−1)(k−2)≠0(k-1)(k-2) \neq 0, i.e., k≠1k \neq 1 and k≠2k \neq 2.
    • Infinitely many solutions: This occurs when the last row is [0,0,0|0][0, 0, 0 | 0]. This happens when (k−1)(k−2)=0(k-1)(k-2) = 0, i.e., k=1k=1 or k=2k=2.
    • Unique solution: This would require a pivot in every column of the coefficient matrix. Since the third column has no pivot, a unique solution is impossible for any value of kk.

Ответ:

  • Unique solution: Never
  • Infinitely many solutions: k=1k=1 or k=2k=2
  • No solution: k≠1k \neq 1 and k≠2k \neq 2
4.94. Пересечение прямой и плоскости (Контрольная, Задание 1a)

Find intersection point P0P_0 between line L:x−12=y−33=−zL: \frac{x-1}{2} = \frac{y-3}{3} = -z and plane π:3x−2y+4z=−1\pi: 3x - 2y + 4z = -1.

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

    So: x=1+2tx = 1 + 2t, y=3+3ty = 3 + 3t, z=−tz = -t

  2. Substitute into plane equation:

    3(1+2t)−2(3+3t)+4(−t)=−13(1 + 2t) - 2(3 + 3t) + 4(-t) = -1 3+6t−6−6t−4t=−13 + 6t - 6 - 6t - 4t = -1 −3−4t=−1-3 - 4t = -1 −4t=2⇒t=−12-4t = 2 \quad \Rightarrow \quad t = -\frac{1}{2}

  3. Find coordinates:

    P0=(1+2(−12),3+3(−12),−(−12))=(0,32,12)P_0 = \left(1 + 2\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right), 3 + 3\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right), -\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)\right) = \left(0, \frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)

Ответ: P0=(0,32,12)P_0 = \left(0, \frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right)

4.97. Классификация взаимного расположения прямых (Контрольная, Задание 1d)

Determine the relationship between:

  • Line 1: x−12=y−23=z−31\frac{x-1}{2} = \frac{y-2}{3} = \frac{z-3}{1}
  • Line 2: x−41=y−13=z−5−2\frac{x-4}{1} = \frac{y-1}{3} = \frac{z-5}{-2}
Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: Check if direction vectors are parallel, then check if lines intersect.

  1. Identify direction vectors:

    𝐝𝟏=(2,3,1)\mathbf{d_1} = (2, 3, 1) and 𝐝𝟐=(1,3,−2)\mathbf{d_2} = (1, 3, -2)

    𝐝𝟏≠k𝐝𝟐\mathbf{d_1} \neq k\mathbf{d_2} for any scalar kk, so not parallel.

  3. Check if intersecting:

    Set up equations: 1+2t=4+s1 + 2t = 4 + s, 2+3t=1+3s2 + 3t = 1 + 3s, 3+t=5−2s3 + t = 5 - 2s

    From first: 2t−s=32t - s = 3 From second: 3t−3s=−13t - 3s = -1 From third: t+2s=2t + 2s = 2

    This system is inconsistent, so lines don’t intersect.

4.98. Плоскости-биссектрисы (Контрольная, Задание 1e)

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: A point lies on a bisector plane if its distances to both planes are equal.

  1. Distance formula:

    For a point (x,y,z)(x, y, z): d1=|2x+2z+3|22+02+22=|2x+2z+3|22d_1 = \frac{|2x + 2z + 3|}{\sqrt{2^2 + 0^2 + 2^2}} = \frac{|2x + 2z + 3|}{2\sqrt{2}} d2=|x+y+2|12+12+02=|x+y+2|2d_2 = \frac{|x + y + 2|}{\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2 + 0^2}} = \frac{|x + y + 2|}{\sqrt{2}}

  2. Set equal:

    |2x+2z+3|22=|x+y+2|2\frac{|2x + 2z + 3|}{2\sqrt{2}} = \frac{|x + y + 2|}{\sqrt{2}} |2x+2z+3|=2|x+y+2||2x + 2z + 3| = 2|x + y + 2|

  3. Case 1: 2x+2z+3=2(x+y+2)2x + 2z + 3 = 2(x + y + 2)

    2y−2z+1=02y - 2z + 1 = 0

  4. Case 2: 2x+2z+3=−2(x+y+2)2x + 2z + 3 = -2(x + y + 2)

    4x+2y+2z+7=04x + 2y + 2z + 7 = 0

Ответ: The bisector planes are 2y−2z+1=02y - 2z + 1 = 0 and 4x+2y+2z+7=04x + 2y + 2z + 7 = 0.

4.99. Смешанное произведение и линейная независимость (Контрольная, Задание 2a)

Given 𝐚=(1,2,3)\mathbf{a} = (1, 2, 3), 𝐛=(2,−1,1)\mathbf{b} = (2, -1, 1), 𝐜=(3,1,−2)\mathbf{c} = (3, 1, -2), compute the scalar triple product and determine if the vectors are linearly independent.

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: The scalar triple product is the determinant of the matrix with vectors as rows (or columns).

  1. Calculate scalar triple product:

    𝐚⋅(𝐛×𝐜)=∣1232−1131−2∣\mathbf{a} \cdot (\mathbf{b} \times \mathbf{c}) = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix}

    =1∣−111−2∣−2∣213−2∣+3∣2−131∣= 1\begin{vmatrix} -1 & 1 \\ 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} - 2\begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -2 \end{vmatrix} + 3\begin{vmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 \end{vmatrix}

    =1(2−1)−2(−4−3)+3(2+3)= 1(2 - 1) - 2(-4 - 3) + 3(2 + 3) =1+14+15=30= 1 + 14 + 15 = 30

  2. Check linear independence:

    Since the scalar triple product ≠0\neq 0, the vectors are linearly independent.

Ответ: Scalar triple product = 3030; vectors are linearly independent.

Find the area of triangle with vertices A(1,2,3)A(1, 2, 3), B(3,0,0)B(3, 0, 0), C(5,2,9)C(5, 2, 9).

  2. Calculate cross product:

    AB→×AC→=∣𝐢𝐣𝐤2−2−3406∣\vec{AB} \times \vec{AC} = \begin{vmatrix} \mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\ 2 & -2 & -3 \\ 4 & 0 & 6 \end{vmatrix}

    =𝐢(−12−0)−𝐣(12−(−12))+𝐤(0−(−8))= \mathbf{i}(-12 - 0) - \mathbf{j}(12 - (-12)) + \mathbf{k}(0 - (-8)) =(−12,−24,8)= (-12, -24, 8)

  3. Find magnitude:

4.101. Тождество двойного векторного произведения (Контрольная, Задание 2c)

Verify the identity 𝐚×(𝐛×𝐜)=(𝐚⋅𝐜)𝐛−(𝐚⋅𝐛)𝐜\mathbf{a} \times (\mathbf{b} \times \mathbf{c}) = (\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{c})\mathbf{b} - (\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b})\mathbf{c} for 𝐚=(1,2,3)\mathbf{a} = (1, 2, 3), 𝐛=(2,−1,1)\mathbf{b} = (2, -1, 1), 𝐜=(3,1,−2)\mathbf{c} = (3, 1, -2).

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: Compute both sides independently and verify equality.

  1. Left side - calculate 𝐛×𝐜\mathbf{b} \times \mathbf{c}:

    𝐛×𝐜=∣𝐢𝐣𝐤2−1131−2∣=(2−1,−(−4−3),2+3)=(1,7,5)\mathbf{b} \times \mathbf{c} = \begin{vmatrix} \mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = (2 - 1, -(-4 - 3), 2 + 3) = (1, 7, 5)

  2. Left side - calculate 𝐚×(1,7,5)\mathbf{a} \times (1, 7, 5):

    𝐚×(𝐛×𝐜)=∣𝐢𝐣𝐤123175∣\mathbf{a} \times (\mathbf{b} \times \mathbf{c}) = \begin{vmatrix} \mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\ 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 7 & 5 \end{vmatrix} =(10−21,−(5−3),7−2)=(−11,−2,5)= (10 - 21, -(5 - 3), 7 - 2) = (-11, -2, 5)

  3. Right side - calculate dot products:

    𝐚⋅𝐜=3+2−6=−1\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{c} = 3 + 2 - 6 = -1 𝐚⋅𝐛=2−2+3=3\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = 2 - 2 + 3 = 3

  4. Right side - final calculation:

    (𝐚⋅𝐜)𝐛−(𝐚⋅𝐛)𝐜(\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{c})\mathbf{b} - (\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b})\mathbf{c} =−1(2,−1,1)−3(3,1,−2)= -1(2, -1, 1) - 3(3, 1, -2) =(−2,1,−1)+(−9,−3,6)= (-2, 1, -1) + (-9, -3, 6) =(−11,−2,5)= (-11, -2, 5)

Ответ: Both sides equal (−11,−2,5)(-11, -2, 5). Identity verified. ✓

4.103. Решение системы: метод Гаусса (Контрольная, Задание 3b-i)

Solve the system using Gaussian elimination: {x+2y+3z=62x+4y+7z=133x+7y+11z=20\begin{cases} x + 2y + 3z = 6 \\ 2x + 4y + 7z = 13 \\ 3x + 7y + 11z = 20 \end{cases}

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: Reduce to REF, then use back substitution.

  1. Write augmented matrix:

    [123624713371120]\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c} 1 & 2 & 3 & 6 \\ 2 & 4 & 7 & 13 \\ 3 & 7 & 11 & 20 \end{array}\right]

  2. Row reduce:

    →R2−2R1[12360011371120]\xrightarrow{R_2 - 2R_1} \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c} 1 & 2 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & 7 & 11 & 20 \end{array}\right]

    →R3−3R1[123600110122]\xrightarrow{R_3 - 3R_1} \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c} 1 & 2 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 2 \end{array}\right]

    →swap R2,R3[123601220011]\xrightarrow{\text{swap } R_2, R_3} \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c} 1 & 2 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array}\right]

  3. Back substitution:

    z=1z = 1 y+2(1)=2⇒y=0y + 2(1) = 2 \Rightarrow y = 0 x+2(0)+3(1)=6⇒x=3x + 2(0) + 3(1) = 6 \Rightarrow x = 3

Ответ: (3,0,1)(3, 0, 1)

    →R2−2R3[120301000011]\xrightarrow{R_2 - 2R_3} \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c} 1 & 2 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array}\right]

4.105. Решение системы: правило Крамера (Контрольная, Задание 3b-iii)

Solve the same system using Cramer’s rule.

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: Calculate determinants DD, DxD_x, DyD_y, DzD_z.

  1. Calculate main determinant:

    D=∣1232473711∣=1(44−49)−2(22−21)+3(14−12)=−5−2+6=−1D = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 7 \\ 3 & 7 & 11 \end{vmatrix} = 1(44-49) - 2(22-21) + 3(14-12) = -5 - 2 + 6 = -1

  2. Calculate DxD_x:

    Dx=∣623134720711∣=6(44−49)−2(143−140)+3(91−80)=−30−6+33=−3D_x = \begin{vmatrix} 6 & 2 & 3 \\ 13 & 4 & 7 \\ 20 & 7 & 11 \end{vmatrix} = 6(44-49) - 2(143-140) + 3(91-80) = -30 - 6 + 33 = -3

  3. Calculate DyD_y:

    Dy=∣163213732011∣=1(143−140)−6(22−21)+3(40−39)=3−6+3=0D_y = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 6 & 3 \\ 2 & 13 & 7 \\ 3 & 20 & 11 \end{vmatrix} = 1(143-140) - 6(22-21) + 3(40-39) = 3 - 6 + 3 = 0

  4. Calculate DzD_z:

    Dz=∣12624133720∣=1(80−91)−2(40−39)+6(14−12)=−11−2+12=−1D_z = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 6 \\ 2 & 4 & 13 \\ 3 & 7 & 20 \end{vmatrix} = 1(80-91) - 2(40-39) + 6(14-12) = -11 - 2 + 12 = -1

  5. Find solution:

    x=DxD=−3−1=3,y=DyD=0−1=0,z=DzD=−1−1=1x = \frac{D_x}{D} = \frac{-3}{-1} = 3, \quad y = \frac{D_y}{D} = \frac{0}{-1} = 0, \quad z = \frac{D_z}{D} = \frac{-1}{-1} = 1

Ответ: (3,0,1)(3, 0, 1)

4.106. Angle Between Planes (Контрольная, Задание 4a)

Find the angle between planes with normal vectors 𝐧𝟏=(1,2,−1)\mathbf{n_1} = (1, 2, -1) and 𝐧𝟐=(3,−1,2)\mathbf{n_2} = (3, -1, 2).

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: Use cosθ=|𝐧𝟏⋅𝐧𝟐|||𝐧𝟏||||𝐧𝟐||\cos\theta = \frac{|\mathbf{n_1} \cdot \mathbf{n_2}|}{||\mathbf{n_1}|| ||\mathbf{n_2}||}.

  1. Calculate dot product:

    𝐧𝟏⋅𝐧𝟐=3−2−2=−1\mathbf{n_1} \cdot \mathbf{n_2} = 3 - 2 - 2 = -1

  2. Calculate magnitudes:

    ||𝐧𝟏||=1+4+1=6||\mathbf{n_1}|| = \sqrt{1 + 4 + 1} = \sqrt{6} ||𝐧𝟐||=9+1+4=14||\mathbf{n_2}|| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 4} = \sqrt{14}

  3. Find angle:

    cosθ=|−1|614=184\cos\theta = \frac{|-1|}{\sqrt{6}\sqrt{14}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{84}} θ=cos−1(184)\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{84}}\right)

Ответ: θ=cos−1(184)≈83.66°\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{84}}\right) \approx 83.66°

4.108. Unique Solution Condition (Контрольная, Задание 4c)

For what values of mm does the system have a unique solution? {x+y+z=1x+my+z=2x+y+mz=3\begin{cases} x + y + z = 1 \\ x + my + z = 2 \\ x + y + mz = 3 \end{cases}

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение

Key Concept: System has unique solution when det(A)≠0\det(A) \neq 0.

  1. Calculate determinant:

    det(A)=det[1111m111m]\det(A) = \det\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & m & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & m \end{bmatrix}

    =1(m2−1)−1(m−1)+1(1−m)= 1(m^2 - 1) - 1(m - 1) + 1(1 - m) =m2−1−m+1+1−m= m^2 - 1 - m + 1 + 1 - m =m2−2m+1=(m−1)2= m^2 - 2m + 1 = (m - 1)^2

  2. Find condition:

    For unique solution: (m−1)2≠0⇒m≠1(m - 1)^2 \neq 0 \Rightarrow m \neq 1

Ответ: m≠1m \neq 1

4.110. Determinant of AᵀA and Parallelogram Area (Домашнее задание 6, Задание 1)

Let u→=(u1,u2,u3)\vec{u} = (u_1, u_2, u_3) and v→=(v1,v2,v3)\vec{v} = (v_1, v_2, v_3) be two vectors in ℝ3\mathbb{R}^3, and consider the parallelogram PP spanned by these vectors. Define the matrix AA by stacking u→\vec{u} and v→\vec{v} as columns: A=[u→v→]=[u1v1u2v2u3v3]A = [\vec{u} \ \vec{v}] = \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & v_1 \\ u_2 & v_2 \\ u_3 & v_3 \end{bmatrix}. Prove that the area of the parallelogram PP is given by: Area =det(ATA)= \sqrt{\det(A^T A)}.

Нажмите, чтобы увидеть решение
  1. Area from Cross Product: The area of a parallelogram spanned by two vectors u→\vec{u} and v→\vec{v} is given by the magnitude of their cross product: Area =||u→×v→||= ||\vec{u} \times \vec{v}||.
  2. Lagrange’s Identity: Squaring the area gives Area2=||u→×v→||2^2 = ||\vec{u} \times \vec{v}||^2. By Lagrange’s identity, the squared magnitude of the cross product can be expressed using dot products: ||u→×v→||2=||u→||2||v→||2−(u→⋅v→)2||\vec{u} \times \vec{v}||^2 = ||\vec{u}||^2 ||\vec{v}||^2 - (\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v})^2.
  3. Compute ATAA^T A: Now let’s compute the determinant of ATAA^T A. First, we find the product ATAA^T A:
    • ATA=[u1u2u3v1v2v3][u1v1u2v2u3v3]A^T A = \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & u_2 & u_3 \\ v_1 & v_2 & v_3 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} u_1 & v_1 \\ u_2 & v_2 \\ u_3 & v_3 \end{bmatrix}
    • =[u12+u22+u32u1v1+u2v2+u3v3v1u1+v2u2+v3u3v12+v22+v32]= \begin{bmatrix} u_1^2+u_2^2+u_3^2 & u_1v_1+u_2v_2+u_3v_3 \\ v_1u_1+v_2u_2+v_3u_3 & v_1^2+v_2^2+v_3^2 \end{bmatrix}
  4. Relate to Dot Products: We can recognize the elements of this matrix as dot products:
    • ATA=[u→⋅u→u→⋅v→v→⋅u→v→⋅v→]=[||u→||2u→⋅v→u→⋅v→||v→||2]A^T A = \begin{bmatrix} \vec{u} \cdot \vec{u} & \vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} \\ \vec{v} \cdot \vec{u} & \vec{v} \cdot \vec{v} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} ||\vec{u}||^2 & \vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} \\ \vec{u} \cdot \vec{v} & ||\vec{v}||^2 \end{bmatrix}.
  5. Calculate the Determinant: Now, we compute the determinant of this 2×22 \times 2 matrix:
    • det(ATA)=(||u→||2)(||v→||2)−(u→⋅v→)(u→⋅v→)=||u→||2||v→||2−(u→⋅v→)2\det(A^T A) = (||\vec{u}||^2)(||\vec{v}||^2) - (\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v})(\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v}) = ||\vec{u}||^2 ||\vec{v}||^2 - (\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v})^2.
  6. Conclusion: The expression for det(ATA)\det(A^T A) is identical to the expression for Area2^2 from Lagrange’s identity in step 2.
    • Therefore, Area2=det(ATA)^2 = \det(A^T A).
    • Taking the square root gives Area =det(ATA)= \sqrt{\det(A^T A)}.
Ответ: The proof is complete.
